issues.jp_before: 部長[ぶちょう]は会議[かいぎ]で新[あたら]しい計画[けいかく]を{おっしゃいました|kg-son-special}。
issues.problem: 計画をおっしゃる is unnatural (one does not 'say a plan'); speaking to an outsider, distractor 申しました would be correct (uchi/soto not fixed).
issues.action: Rewrote as a と-quote (来月から新しい計画を始めるとおっしゃいました) and added '(speaking to a colleague)' to the English.

issues.jp_before: お客様[きゃくさま]、こちらでしばらく{お待[ま]ちください|kg-o-kudasai}。
issues.problem: English 'Sir,' assumes the customer's gender, which the Japanese does not state.
issues.action: English changed to 'Please wait here for a little while (said to a customer).'

issues.jp_before: 課長[かちょう]はもう会議室[かいぎしつ]に{いらっしゃいます|kg-son-special}。
issues.problem: Said to an outside party, distractor おります would be correct; the audience was not fixed.
issues.action: Added '(speaking to a colleague)' to the English.

issues.jp_before: 社長[しゃちょう]は毎朝[まいあさ]六時[ろくじ]に会社[かいしゃ]に{来[こ]られます|kg-rareru}。
issues.problem: Said to an outside party, distractor 参ります becomes defensible; the audience was not fixed.
issues.action: Added '(speaking to a colleague)' to the English.

issues.jp_before: 申[もう]し訳[わけ]ございません、そちらの商品[しょうひん]は今[いま]在庫[ざいこ]が{ございません|kg-gozaimasu}。
issues.problem: The apology needs が before the comma to lead into the explanation (申し訳ございませんが、).
issues.action: Changed to 申し訳ございませんが、.

issues.jp_before: 私[わたし]は山田先生[やまだせんせい]のお名前[なまえ]だけは{存[ぞん]じております|kg-ken-special}。
issues.problem: 存じ上げております (the standard humble form for knowing a person or their name) is equally natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added 存じ上げております as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]に、一[ひと]つ質問[しつもん]を{伺[うかが]ってもよろしいでしょうか|kg-ken-special}。
issues.problem: 質問を伺う means hearing someone else's question, not asking one, so the Japanese did not match 'May I ask you one question'.
issues.action: Rewrote as 先生、一つ伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。 / 'Professor, may I ask you one thing?'

issues.jp_before: 先輩[せんぱい]に就職[しゅうしょく]の相談[そうだん]を聞[き]いて{いただきました|kg-teitadaku}。
issues.problem: The 'why' said に marks the receiver, but に marks the senior, who did the favour. The distractor させていただきました is ill-formed on the て-stem (聞いてさせていただきました). 相談を聞く is also less natural than 相談に乗る.
issues.action: Rewrote as 相談に乗っていただきました; English 'My senior kindly gave me advice about finding a job.'; replaced that distractor with おりました; corrected the 'why'.

issues.jp_before: 面接[めんせつ]の前[まえ]に、受付[うけつけ]でお名前[なまえ]を{お書[か]きください|kg-o-kudasai}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item 'お名前をご記入ください' (asking for a name on a form, same skill).
issues.action: Replaced with 試験中は、携帯電話の電源をお切りください。 (kg-o-kudasai), distractors お切りします / お切りになります / お切りいたします.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]は夏休[なつやす]みに家族[かぞく]と旅行[りょこう]に{行[い]かれます|kg-rareru}。
昨日[きのう]、私[わたし]は先生[せんせい]のお宅[たく]へ{参[まい]りました|kg-ken-special}。
issues.problem: 伺いました (humble form for visiting a respected person's home) is at least as natural but was not listed.
issues.action: Added 伺いました as an alternative.
